definitions.full: H6604. Pthowr מְּתוֺר proper name, of a location home of Balsam ; — with ה locative מְּת֫וֺרָה Num 22:5 , φαθουρα , A Βαθουρα ; נַהֲרַיִם ׳פ אֲרַם Deut 23:5 , but omitted ᵐ5 ׳פ ; — compare Assyrian Pitru (on western bank of upper Euphrase) Schr KGF 220 ; COT Num 22:5 Dl Pa 269 Dr Hastings DB; Egyptian Pe-d-ru WMM As.u.Eur:291 . [ מָּתוֺת ] see פתת .

occurrences.englishText: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.
Nevertheless Yahweh your God wouldn’t listen to Balaam, but Yahweh your God turned the curse into a blessing to you, because Yahweh your God loved you.
